headline: On October 9, 1942: Australia gains full legislative independence
captionCards: Westminster relinquished nearly all legislative authority over Australia
Acting as de jure sovereign nations after adopting UK statute sections
instagramCaption:
Australia severs final legislative ties with Britain.

The Statute of Westminster Adoption Act 1942 received royal assent on October 9. This act formally adopted sections 2–6 of the UK's Statute of Westminster 1931. Westminster relinquished nearly all authority to legislate for the Dominions. This enactment effectively made Australia a de jure sovereign nation.

This shift established the legal foundation for modern Australian self-governance.

Did you know Australia waited until WWII to finalize this status?
